newsitem.title: CHILE: Entel-Chile Sept intl telecom share slips.
newsitem.headline: Entel-Chile Sept intl telecom share slips.

text.p: Entel-Chile's share of international telephone traffic fell in September compared with August, although the firm's national traffic rose slightly in the same period, said the telecommunications subsecretariat.
The government figures showed Entel's international market share in the competitive multicarrier service dropped to 36.63 percent in September from 40.77 percent in August.
Its national traffic increased to 41.37 percent in September from 40.77 percent in the previous month.
After losing market share in recent months, Telex-Chile SA's Chilesat unit's share of international traffic rose to 13.51 percent in September from 12.67 percent in August.
